Expert Consulting

Design Review & Feasibility

Full Planning Package

The 4-Hour Walkthrough

A recorded tour of the complete build. From foundation to finishes. Learn what works, what we'd do differently, and why.

What You'll Learn

🏗️ Foundation & Site

Pier foundation design, site preparation, why we chose this approach.

📦 Container Modification

Cutting openings, reinforcing structure, integrating MEP systems.

⚡ Electrical Systems

Main panel, circuits, load calculations, grounding, efficiency design.

💧 Plumbing & Water

Supply lines, fixtures, septic integration, water management.

🌡️ Thermal & HVAC

Insulation strategy, ventilation, temperature control solutions.

🏠 Interiors & Finishes

Layout decisions, materials selection, storage design for 750 sq ft.

The Honest Part

✓ The Good

  • Learn from actual systems and real decisions
  • No theory—just what actually works
  • Understand what we'd do differently and why
  • See a completed, lived-in home
  • Access to people who built it

⚠️ The Realities

  • It's not a luxury project showcase
  • You're learning from our specific choices—yours may differ
  • Some systems are custom; not all are replicable
  • Better suited for curious learners than casual observers
  • 4 hours is a deep dive, not a highlight reel

If you're looking for authentic knowledge and honest insights, this is for you. If you're looking for a polished marketing video, look elsewhere.
